description: Utility functions for encoding and decoding video IDs with provider information, including base64 encoding/decoding and extraction of original video IDs.

classes.name: DecodedVideoId
classes.description: Data class representing the decoded components of a video ID, including provider, model ID, and video ID.

methods.name: encode_video_id_with_provider
methods.description: Encodes provider and optional model ID into a base64 string prefixed with 'video_'.

methods.name: decode_video_id_with_provider
methods.description: Decodes a base64-encoded video ID string to extract provider, model ID, and original video ID.

methods.name: extract_original_video_id
methods.description: Retrieves the original video ID from an encoded video ID.
